anti_overlap: Do not adjudicate formal benchmark-construct continuity or the rhetoric of changing OUTCOME to PATH; fd-tibetan-debate-entailment-cox owns that question.
Do not question the paired-seed arithmetic or provenance unless a contradiction appears in the target file.
Do not optimize wall-clock scheduling beyond identifying the cheapest measurement that distinguishes path changes from footprint changes.
decision_lens: Favor mechanisms that create persistent, spatially heterogeneous refugia or recovery pathways capable of changing which countries remain below catastrophe at the century boundary. Discount interventions that diversify routes while leaving the same terminal support saturated.
distance_rationale: Delta avulsion is a non-human geomorphic process operating across centuries and entire sedimentary basins. It is remote from software evaluation and game calibration while offering a precise distinction between stochastic propagation routes and an invariant eventual footprint.
expected_isomorphisms: Distributary channels map to cascade edges and per-seed propagation routes.
Avulsion timing and lobe switching map to timing dispersion and epicenter diversity.
The preserved basin-wide sediment footprint maps to final cat_share and the identity of surviving countries.
Accommodation-space saturation maps to the 0.982798835 terminal ceiling reached by every full-world seed.
Natural levees, infiltration, and abandoned lobes map to heterogeneous resistance, recovery, and persistent refugia.
A reduced experimental flume maps to the certified 10-country graph: variable outcomes may arise from constrained extent rather than correct full-world dynamics.
focus: Terminal-footprint diagnosis: whether each Stage B resolution changes only cascade routing and arrival time or actually restores seed-dependent survivor geography and final catastrophe share.
name: fd-delta-avulsion-footprint-cox
persona: Apply the perspective of a river-delta avulsion geomorphologist reconstructing centuries of distributary switching from stratigraphic deposits. Distinguish variable channels from invariant basin fill, route noise from accommodation limits, and local refugia from mere slowing of the same inevitable footprint.
review_areas: Read the matched-position IQR result as route-versus-footprint evidence: similar timing spread can coexist with a fixed terminal inundation footprint, so path variability must not be mistaken for outcome variability.

Evaluate option A as distributary avulsion: seeded edge sampling is useful only if it changes terminal reach or survivor identity; otherwise it injects route noise while the same basin fills. Require the intermediate-coverage onset curve to locate that regime.

Evaluate option D through accommodation, infiltration, and abandonment analogues: resistance and recovery must be local, stateful, and capable of arresting or reversing catastrophe, not another uniform coefficient that translates the same sigmoid.

Evaluate option B as a legitimate channel-path certification that openly declines to certify the terminal footprint; retain epicenter diversity only with an explicit product decision that invariant endings are acceptable.

Evaluate option C as shrinking the receiving basin rather than repairing its dynamics: acknowledge restored variance but price the loss of authoritative geography and the measured reduction in CHN epicenter dominance.

Specify cheap discriminators before n=256: survivor-set cardinality and identity variance, final cat_share distinctness, recovery-event counts, and matched-position timing should expose whether a proposal changes footprint, path, or both.

severity_examples.condition: That result changes distributary paths while preserving the saturated terminal footprint, so it does not address the measured cause of both failed gates.
severity_examples.scenario: Option A is declared a causal fix after it restores epicenter or route diversity but all seeds still converge on the same final survivor set and cat_share.

severity_examples.condition: A uniform scalar is structurally adjacent to the already falsified propagation_rate and crisis_threshold levers and is likely to move the curve without creating seed-dependent refugia.
severity_examples.scenario: Option D is implemented as one global resistance or recovery scalar applied uniformly to all countries.

severity_examples.condition: The expensive ladder would be spent before verifying that the treatment changes the terminal footprint rather than only timing or path.
severity_examples.scenario: A full n=256 confirmatory run is launched before a byte-level or n=32 check records survivor identity variance and final cat_share distinctness.

source_domain: River-delta avulsion geomorphology and stratigraphy: distributary channel switching, accommodation-space filling, lobe abandonment, crevasse splays, and preserved terminal sediment footprints over centuries.
success_hints: For every option, predict separately what should happen to route diversity, matched-position timing IQR, final cat_share variance, and survivor-set variance.
Treat identical surviving countries across all seeds as stronger evidence of footprint saturation than the single aggregate cat_share value alone.
Prefer heterogeneous, state-dependent resistance or recovery with observable local mechanisms over a new global dial.
Use the intermediate-coverage sweep to identify the transition from incomplete reach to saturated footprint before choosing any edge-retention probability.
Recommend a staged test that rejects path-only changes at n=32 before paying for n=256.
task_context: Decide how ShadowBench should resolve Phase 6 Stage B given a newly MEASURED result: turning on real 218-country cascade geography makes the century's ending deterministic. Final cat_share is exactly 0.982798835 in all 32 paired seeds (sd 0.000000000, ONE distinct value), versus 32 distinct values spanning 0.486-0.658 at the certified 10-country coverage. Critically, coverage does NOT reduce TIMING dispersion at all -- at matched relative position on each arm's own curve the IQR ratio is 1.03 (50% of ceiling) and 0.89 (60%). The apparent 4x collapse at the certification gate is threshold placement: T0 is a fixed absolute cat_share>0.5, which is 85% of the 10-country ceiling (flat saturating tail) but 51% of the full-world ceiling (steep mid-limb). So jackpot-cal-v2 was converting CEILING spread into TIMING spread, and Stage B raised the ceiling 0.588->0.983 and zeroed its variance, failing incidence (1.0000 vs band [0.90,0.98]) and IQR (45 vs gate 240) from that single cause. No threshold re-cut recovers it: swept 51-100% of ceiling, incidence stays 1.0000 everywhere. Three calibration levers are already falsified with evidence: graph topology (7x mean-degree cut, 2944->411 edges, NO distributional change), propagation_rate (location-only: median 361.5/451.5/519.0, IQR 45.5/43.0/47.0), and crisis_threshold (location-only AND domain-exhausted -- the required value is 4.87 but pressures are clamped to [0,1]). Evaluate and rank four candidate resolutions, and propose better ones if they exist: (A) per-seed seeded edge sampling of the real CEPII graph to restore outcome variance while keeping authoritative geography; (B) re-cut the gates to certify PATH not OUTCOME, keeping epicenter diversity G1 which passed in every arm all session (7-8 distinct epicenters, max share ~0.31) and a T0 median band, dropping IQR; (C) revert Stage B to the certified 10-country graph, losing affordance #7 and the real improvement that CHN epicenter dominance fell 49.4%->8% under true geography; (D) attack the ceiling itself by adding resistance/recovery so countries can genuinely survive and WHICH ones endure becomes seed-dependent, addressing the arguably deeper defect that 98.3% of world GDP ends catastrophic every single run. Weigh: is a deterministic century ending a product regression independent of any gate, or is a 218-country world legitimately more determined than a 10-country toy and the gate should follow the physics? Judge each option on whether it fixes the measured cause rather than its symptom, on certification cost against the existing ladder (byte referee -> n=32 dial -> n=256 confirmatory + mod battery, ~4.5h per n=256 on a 32-core box), and on whether it introduces yet another calibration constant. Note one outstanding measurement, deliberately not run: the ONSET coverage at which outcome variance dies, which needs intermediate coverage points (~1.5h bench) and would be required to size option A's edge probability.
